## Pull request overview

Implements Phase 4 “complex & business components” by adding new ListView/DetailView plugins and enhancing existing Dashboard/Kanban/Chatbot plugins with enterprise-oriented capabilities and new dependencies.

**Changes:**
- Added `@object-ui/plugin-list` (ListView + view switching) and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (DetailView + sections/tabs/related lists).
- Enhanced dashboard with an editable `react-grid-layout`-based grid layout component and added Kanban/Chatbot “enhanced” implementations.
- Wired new plugins into the console app and added Storybook JSON stories + example pages.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 40 out of 42 changed files in this pull request and generated 18 comments.

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused variable rerender.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/314)

`data` is captured once via `useState(schema.data)` and never updates if `schema.data` changes (e.g., schema re-render with new record data). Unless this is intentionally a one-time snapshot, use `schema.data` directly or sync state in an effect so the detail page reflects updates.
```suggestion
  const data = schema.data;
```

`handleDragEnd` reordering within the same column assumes `over.id` is a card id. However, this board also registers each column with `useSortable({ id: column.id })`, so `over.id` can be the column id when dropping on empty space. In that case `newIndex` becomes `-1` and `arrayMove` produces incorrect results. Handle the “dropped on column container” case (e.g., treat as move-to-end) before calling `arrayMove`.

`KanbanEnhanced.tsx` exports a default component, but the test imports it as a named export (`{ KanbanEnhanced }`). This will be `undefined` at runtime in ESM and cause the test to fail. Either export `KanbanEnhanced` as a named export (and optionally re-export it as default) or update the test to use a default import.

These dashboard stories introduce `enableGridLayout` / `persistLayout` / `enableEditMode` on `type: 'dashboard'`, but `DashboardRenderer` doesn’t read those flags. The new grid editor is registered as `type: 'dashboard-grid'`, so these stories won’t actually render the editable grid. Either switch the story `type` to `dashboard-grid` (and pass the expected props) or update `dashboard` to delegate to `DashboardGridLayout` when `enableGridLayout` is true.

`dashboardComponents` is labeled as the “Standard Export Protocol”, but it no longer maps schema type strings to components (it exports an object keyed by component identifiers instead). This breaks manual integration patterns used by other plugins (e.g. `chartComponents` uses string keys). Consider restoring string keys like `'dashboard'`, `'dashboard-grid'`, etc., or rename/remove this export if it’s not intended to be a type map.

The generated schemas for `'kanban'` and `'chart'` views use component types `'object-kanban'` and `'object-chart'`, but there is no `ComponentRegistry.register('object-kanban'| 'object-chart', ...)` in the repo (only `'kanban'`/`'kanban-enhanced'` and `'chart'`). As-is, these view types won’t render correctly. Either register ObjectQL renderers for these schema types or switch to the existing registered types and adapt the props accordingly.

The README’s `ListViewSchema.viewType` example doesn’t match the implementation/types: it omits `'list'` (supported by the component) and includes `'gantt' | 'map'` (allowed by `@object-ui/types` but not implemented in `ListView.tsx`). Please align the documented union with what’s actually supported (or extend the implementation to cover the documented values).

`data-table` expects `columns` to be an array of column objects (it normalizes `header/accessorKey`), but `RelatedList` forwards `columns` as-is. In the demo/story usage, `columns` is often a `string[]`, which will break the table (strings don’t have `header/accessorKey`). Consider normalizing `string[]` to `{ header: str, accessorKey: str }[]` (and/or documenting/enforcing the expected shape).

The `detail_view_demo` tabs omit the required `content` field (per `DetailViewTab` in `@object-ui/types` and `DetailTabs` renderer). As configured, `DetailTabs` will attempt to render `SchemaRenderer` with `undefined` schema. Add a `content` schema for each tab (or omit `tabs` entirely for this demo).
```suggestion

```

Several tests pass props like `enableCollapse` to `KanbanEnhanced`, but `KanbanEnhancedProps` doesn’t define them and the implementation doesn’t branch on them. This makes the tests misleading (and would be a type error under type-checking). Either implement the prop(s) or remove them from the tests and stories.

These new Kanban stories set props like `enableVirtualScrolling` / `enableCollapse` on `type: 'kanban'`, but the `kanban` renderer in `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` doesn’t forward those props (they’re only supported by the separately registered `type: 'kanban-enhanced'`). Update the story schemas to use `kanban-enhanced` if the intent is to demo the enhanced implementation.

`currentView` is initialized via `(schema.viewType as ViewType)`, but `ListViewSchema.viewType` includes values like `'gantt' | 'map'` (see `@object-ui/types`) that aren’t handled by `ViewType` or the `switch`. If one of those values comes in, the `default` branch returns an object without a `type`, which can break `SchemaRenderer`. Please validate/normalize `schema.viewType` (and any saved localStorage value) to supported views, or implement handlers for the additional view types.

`relatedData` is initialized from `data` via `useState(data)` but never updated when the `data` prop changes, so `RelatedList` can display stale results. Prefer rendering directly from `data` (or sync state in an effect) unless you intentionally want a one-time snapshot.

These stories use `type: 'chatbot'` but rely on enhanced-only props like `enableMarkdown`, code highlighting, and file upload. In this PR those props are wired on the separately registered `type: 'chatbot-enhanced'`, so the story won’t actually exercise the enhanced renderer. Update the stories to use `chatbot-enhanced` (or make the base `chatbot` renderer delegate when these props are present).

`RelatedListProps` uses a prop named `type`, which collides with the schema’s required `type` discriminator. Since `SchemaRenderer` hoists `properties` via `Object.assign(newSchema, newSchema.properties)`, a config like `{ type: 'related-list', properties: { type: 'table' } }` would overwrite the component type and fail to resolve. Consider renaming this prop to something like `viewType`/`variant` (and optionally supporting `type` as a deprecated alias).
